prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a low-speed head-on collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1162; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent the interests of our client in connection with the motor vehicle collision described in your file. Our client sustained injuries in a low-speed head-on collision and is currently receiving medical care. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, either by telephone or in writing.

We request that you provide the bodily injury liability limits of each policy that may apply to the insured driver and vehicle involved in this incident, along with a certified copy of the declarations page for each policy. Please also confirm whether any excess or umbrella coverage exists.

We further demand that your company preserve all evidence relating to this collision. This includes the claim file, photographs, vehicle data and telematics records, recorded statements, adjuster notes, repair estimates, and any electronic communications. Please ensure that no such material is altered, discarded, or repaired without prior written notice to this office.

We look forward to your prompt written response.
